name: QwikPlayer brand draft A: Speed + Play

gradient.name: Afterburn
gradient.use: App icon background, played part of the seek bar (Volt at 0:00, Ember at the playhead), thumbnail progress, start-screen glow, the two triangles of the wordmark. Never behind body text.

colors.name: Volt
colors.use: Primary buttons (Open file, Play), selected speed/quality pill, focus ring, selected library card outline, Android colorPrimary, links on the light web theme.

colors.name: Ember
colors.use: Secondary call to action (Resume), seek-bar playhead glow, chapter markers, download/cast highlights, Android colorSecondary.

colors.name: Pulse
colors.use: Gradient only, plus small live/recording dots. Not for text or large fills (too close to Error).

colors.name: Spark
colors.use: The play-triangle tail of the icon, NEW/unwatched badges, rating stars, warnings.

colors.name: Volt Light
colors.use: Links, active toggle icons (subtitles on, loop on) and selected tab labels on dark surfaces.

colors.name: Background
colors.use: Player canvas/letterbox, library page, start screen, web app and Android window background.

colors.name: Surface
colors.use: Control bar, cards, menus, settings panels, Android surface / bottom sheet.

colors.name: Raised
colors.use: Hovered rows and cards, tooltips, seek-preview bubble, dialogs.

colors.name: Border
colors.use: Dividers, outlined buttons, input outlines, drop-zone dashes.

colors.name: Text
colors.use: Titles, primary labels, player control icons.

colors.name: Muted
colors.use: Durations, metadata, secondary labels, inactive icons.

colors.name: Error
colors.use: Playback/codec errors, destructive actions. Always paired with an icon or label, never colour alone.

colors.name: Ink
colors.use: Wordmark on light backgrounds, text on Ember/Spark/Success, light web theme text.

colors.name: Paper
colors.use: Light web theme / docs / store listing background.

start_screen.background: #0D0B14 with soft Volt (20%) and Pulse (10%) corner glows

android_app.adaptive_icon: icon-maskable.svg (glyph sits inside the 66/108 safe circle)
